instruction: Let f(x) = sin(x) + x^3. Compute f''(pi). Write the answer as a decimal rounded to two decimal places (always exactly two digits after the point). Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
